This is a legitimate, rule-consistent distinction from CHK-001/006/007, verified by reading the actual check text and the contract's two additional C5 brake rules -- not an arbitrary carve-out.

New, non-blocking data-quality finding surfaced by this round's independent claim-index rebuild (not previously named in rounds 1-5): intermediate/doc/DOC-06.json contains two structurally distinct claims both minted under claim_id 'CLM-06-021' (one validation_rule about amount min/max boundaries, one side_effect about balance debit on negative-amount entries); both also self-reference their own claim_id in related_claim_ids. This is a doc-ingest-explorer ID-minting defect confined to DOC-06, pre-existing (not touched by this round's rework, which only modified 3 product-kb/checklist files), and already transparently disclosed by qa-knowledge-normalizer in custom-conversion-entry.json's own observations[]. Zero live impact: the normalizer correctly disambiguated by quote-matching into two separate, correctly-labeled KB items (KB-020, KB-021). Grepped all 25 DOC-*.json files for any other claim_id collision: this is the only one in the entire run. Not leaked into publish-preview. Routed as a MINOR, non-blocking note for doc-ingest-explorer (future runs), not a rework target for this publish.
